entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. I just don't like it.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, David. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 23rd. That was about 25 days ago.

Well, unfortunately, for a wearable device that's in direct contact with the skin, we have a very strict return policy due to hygiene and sanitation reasons. After 20 days, it's considered a bio-contaminant risk, so I'm afraid it's too late to process a return for this item.
Of course it is. Figures. Whatever.
Actually... you know what, hold on one second. Let me just double-check the main knowledge base here. I want to be absolutely sure.

Okay, thank you for your patience. It looks like I was mistaken, my apologies. The internal policy guide I have access to still states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. The hygiene rule must be a new guideline that hasn't been formally implemented yet.

Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email right now. You should see it in the next five minutes.
Great. Finally. Just send the label.
It's on its way. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
